sources.title: Airflow Application Guidelines - Split Ducted Units, Doc 0520-026 Ver 1
sources.basis: manufacturer design guideline: return grilles sized at 2.5 m/s on FREE area; return duct max 4 m/s; tables per model
sources.notes: Min/max/recommended return grille free areas per EVV/EFV model; says upsize one size for max airflow; identify a return path per zone (undercut doors or extra return duct); master bedroom/theatre may need a dedicated return/transfer duct.

sources.title: Installation Best Practice Guidelines - Ducted Type Systems, DB0817 v1.7
sources.basis: installer guideline: 2-2.5 m/s for return grille selection; flex duct max L/s table (= 4.0 m/s for 350-550 mm); ESP 125 Pa (VFT), <=250 Pa total
sources.notes: Flex duct table columns are mislabelled in the PDF (diameter vs L/s swapped); read as diameter -> max L/s. Checklist: return grille size considers noise and static.

sources.title: Purtech Return Air Grille - catalogue sheets C-PT 1 to C-PT 5
sources.page: C-PT 1 (dims, effective face area), C-PT 3 (performance chart)
sources.basis: lab chart: clean-filter pressure drop vs L/s for 3 grille sizes with 3-layer electrostatic filter, NR20-35 contours; filter test AS1324 G2 at 2.02 m/s
sources.notes: Values digitised from a log-log chart (about +/-10%). Velocities computed on the published 'effective face area' (0.529/0.309/0.337 m2). Neck connections 200-400 mm (200-550 on 750x550).

sources.title: Slimline Heating Return Air Grille - catalogue sheets C-SG 1 to C-SG 3
sources.basis: lab chart grille+filter clean pressure vs L/s with NR contours; honeycomb filter ASHRAE 52.1 at 1.02 m/s
sources.notes: Wall grille, hole 562x382. Digitised from chart (+/-10%).

sources.title: Filtered Eggcrate Grille Hinged - product data pages (FE series)
sources.basis: L/s published at 1.5 m/s core velocity, core area listed; G2 polyester filter; free area >90%
sources.notes: Gives the only complete published L/s-per-size table for filter grilles found in AU/NZ. The '600x300' page lists neck 600x350 but core 0.167 m2 (fits 600x300).

sources.title: Hinged Eggcrate Grille H-R5-F data sheet
sources.basis: lab tested (Louis A. Challis & Assoc., Sydney): L/s and NR vs neck velocity per size; static pressure vs L/s per neck area; ~90% free area
sources.notes: 12 mm filter standard on this model but the test sheet does not say whether the filter was fitted; pressures (7.5 Pa at ~2.3 m/s) look grille-only.

sources.title: Door Grille DG data sheet (inverted-V blade, ~50% free area)
sources.basis: lab tested static pressure (Pa) vs L/s per neck area
sources.notes: Transfer/door grille.

sources.title: RL - Exhaust & Return Grilles, performance data (RL25)
sources.basis: core velocity (core area ~94% of nominal) vs m3/s, neg. SP and NC (10 dB room absorption)
sources.notes: 30 deg curved fixed-blade commercial return louvre. Text extraction interleaves rows; read block by block. Also: 45 deg passive-ventilation models 'do not exceed 2.5 m/s core'.

sources.title: RLW & AMG - Return Louvers & Grilles, AMG performance data
sources.basis: aluminium diamond-mesh return grille: core velocity vs m3/s, neg. SP, NC
sources.notes: Filtered hinged option AMGFR exists but no filter pressure data published.

sources.title: DG door grille, performance data (DG-52)
sources.basis: core velocity vs neg. SP and NC
sources.notes: Sight-proof door/transfer grille.

sources.title: Brivis Classic Installer's Manual - BX3, 2PWN, UF3, DF3 series, Issue E
sources.basis: minimum return grille opening area (egg-crate) WITHOUT and WITH filter per heater, against published fan airflow at 50/125 Pa
sources.notes: Velocities computed = rated airflow / listed grille area. Area is the free ventilation opening (e.g. 400x650 = 0.26 m2), i.e. nominal opening. With-filter area is ~1.45x the no-filter area.

sources.title: RAG-X return air grille kits - product pages
sources.basis: kit pairing of grille neck size with spigot count/diameter only
sources.notes: No airflow, free area or pressure data published (catalogue behind login).

sources.title: Design memo CCC-DM-2025-062: Return air pathways and transfer air design
sources.basis: consulting-engineer rules of thumb (cites AS 1668.2, AIRAH DA03, NCC J6)
sources.notes: Commercial-leaning; transfer velocity 1.5-2.5 m/s conflicts with its own 3 Pa limit, so treat transfer velocity as noise-based. Author unnamed.

sources.title: 2023 ASHRAE Handbook - HVAC Applications, Ch. 49 Noise and Vibration Control, Tables 8 and 9
sources.basis: acoustic limits by RC(N); Table 9 = 'free' opening velocity at return registers; Table 8 main duct velocities, branches ~80%, final runouts <=50%
sources.notes: For use when no grille sound data exist; reduce for multiple grilles.

sources.title: Air Distribution Engineering guide - 'Recommended Return Inlet Face Velocities'
sources.basis: gross-area face velocity by inlet location; door louvres and undercuts 200-300 fpm
sources.notes: Commercial noise/draft guidance, not pressure-balance based.

sources.publisher: ACCA (Manual D Table 3-1, via ACCA verification brochure)
sources.title: Verifying ACCA Manual D Procedures - Recommended Velocity (FPM) (Manual D, Table 3-1)
sources.basis: residential duct design velocity table (recommended/maximum; rigid/flex) plus example device pressure losses
sources.notes: Brochure undated (hosted 2012). Table A1-1 300 fpm filter-grille limit confirmed separately via CEC staff paper. Section 4-10 / Table A1-1 originals not accessed (paywalled).

sources.title: Staff Analysis of Air Filter Pressure Drop and Air Filter Sizing (Title 24 2019 rulemaking)
sources.basis: cites ANSI/ACCA Manual D 3rd ed. (2009) Table A1-1 = 300 fpm max filter-grille face velocity; Title 24 option 150 fpm with <=0.1 in.wc filter; lab test of 15 filters at 295 fpm
sources.notes: Lab dP values read from Table 1 (24x24 filters at 295 fpm).

sources.title: Using the Engineering Data (residential grilles/registers catalogue intro)
sources.basis: face velocity on Ak (lab-measured effective area); returns 400-600 fpm max; filter returns 450 fpm max; quotes ACCA 300 filter / 500 non-filter; 2 cfm per in2 of filter
sources.notes: Undated; current catalogue pages are 01-2026.

sources.title: 80 Egg Crate Return Grille - catalogue performance data (0 deg, 1/2 in core)
sources.basis: ASHRAE 70-2023 test; core velocity (core ~90-95% of nominal) vs cfm, neg. SP, NC; filter dP NOT included on FF/FH models
sources.notes: Converted to metric.

sources.title: STG/ATG Transfer Grille - catalogue performance data
sources.basis: core velocity vs neg. static pressure and NC for sight-proof transfer grille
sources.notes: Converted to metric.

sources.title: 30/30 High-Capacity Pleated Panel Filter (MERV 8) product sheet #1002-0416
sources.basis: spec limits: initial resistance <=0.23/0.31/0.27 in.wg at 350/500/500 fpm for 1/2/4 in deep; final 1.0 in.wg; rated 250 fpm medium / 500 high (2 & 4 in), 175/350 (1 in)
sources.notes: A commercial-grade pleated reference for clean/dirty filter dP.

sources.publisher: Energy Vanguard / Green Building Advisor (Allison Bailes)
sources.title: Designing Return Filter Grille Boxes
sources.basis: design rule 2 ft2 filter per 400 cfm (~200 fpm) plus measured MERV-13 dP
sources.notes: Low-velocity high-MERV practice.

sources.title: Door Undercuts for Return Air
sources.basis: cites FSEC study (1 in undercut ~60 cfm, ~2 cfm/in2) and Semmelhack field tests (1/2 in undercut <3 Pa to ~80 cfm)

sources.title: RR-0005 Transfer Grille Sizing / BA-0006 Use of Transfer Grilles in Central Return Systems
sources.basis: orifice equation Q[cfm]=1.07 A[in2] sqrt(dP[Pa]) at 3 Pa; grille net free 70-75%; free area to be increased (x1/0.6 hi-lo wall, x1/0.7 through-wall/jump duct); 32x1/2 in undercut credited
sources.notes: Re-published by BSC Press 2008. Typical grille free areas (Ameri-Flow, Grainger 2001) also listed. Hi-low transfer max ~125 cfm; door undercut >=1 in still required.

sources.title: National Rater Field Checklist Rev. 14, item 6.2 and footnote 25
sources.basis: bedroom pressure balance limit with doors closed, all air handlers on

sources.title: What Airflow Goes Around Has to Come Around (return paths; cites ACCA Manual D Table N3-2 and Section N4)
sources.basis: secondary summary of Manual D undercut table and jumper/transfer pressure limits; Raymer rule
sources.notes: Secondary; table itself shown as image.

sources.title: Sizing Return Grilles
sources.basis: 400 fpm target; Richardson rule 2 cfm per in2 of filter grille
sources.notes: Secondary/practitioner.

sources.basis: recommended door-grille transfer velocity 0.75-1.25 m/s
sources.notes: Read from search-index snippet only (page returned 403); treat as unverified.
